interpretation: On the finalized leakage-free held-out-family split, the frozen QLSTM does not demonstrate a gain-prediction advantage over the classical LSTM or constant train-mean predictor. The result must be retained without post-test retuning. Closed-loop evaluation remains scientifically necessary because regression error in Kp/Ki does not by itself establish frequency-control performance.

closed_loop_policy.closed_loop_purpose: Evaluate control-level consequences of already frozen gain schedulers; not to rescue or tune the QLSTM after its test result.
before_closed_loop_simulation: Freeze gain-update cadence separately from the 20-Hz ML observation cadence.
Freeze fallback behavior for invalid or unsafe model outputs.
Predefine closed-loop scenarios before examining comparative control results.
